description: Source code implementing an E1 network client factory with notifiers for converting E1AP PDUs between packed and unpacked forms, managing SCTP connections, and forwarding messages between E1 GW and CU-UP components.

classes.name: sctp_to_e1_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier converting packed E1AP PDUs from E1 GW into unpacked form and forwarding to CU-UP.

classes.name: e1_to_sctp_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier converting unpacked E1AP PDUs from CU-UP into packed form and forwarding to SCTP gateway.

classes.name: e1_sctp_gateway_client
classes.description: Client managing SCTP connection for E1 network, handling connection requests and message forwarding.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_connection_request
methods.description: Establishes SCTP connection to CU-CP and returns notifier for message forwarding.
